works.title: Vulnerable Foundations of Conservative Power
works.description: A multipart analytical book examining structural vulnerabilities and contradictions within conservative power systems. Part III explores how conservative hierarchy maintains itself through interlocking systems that contain inherent weaknesses: security-state expansion that can turn on its creators, generational wealth transfer that sacrifices youth futures, and meritocratic myths that perpetuate inherited advantage while blocking real social mobility.
works.quote: We are writing a book. The master outline is below. We are writing chapters in PART III: THE VULNERABLE FOUNDATIONS OF CONSERVATIVE POWER
